verdict.rationale: Unity documents building one project for different platforms through build profiles, claims 25+ supported platforms, and its Build Automation builds for multiple platforms at once, including iOS. A community comment corroborates its cross-platform and iOS strength. Desktop and console targets are never named explicitly, and nothing describes console access directly or via partners. missing for 10: explicit desktop target documentation, explicit console export documentation (direct or via partner programs), independent hands-on corroboration of console builds

support.subject: As a studio lead, one project exports to desktop, mobile, and (directly or via partners) consoles

citations.quote: Unity can build your application for different platforms with unique build configurations using build profiles in the Unity Editor.
builds for multiple platforms simultaneously, including iOS
What Unity offers is a solid way to build cross platform and target iOS.
